policy: Keep every confirmed defect and its evidence. A local green is not a GitHub exact-SHA pass. Do not mark an entry verified until its fix SHA has passing hosted evidence.

entries.title: Persistence fabricated a receive time when a userFills fill lacked one
entries.root_cause: store_user_fills_live_result used now_ms() as a fallback for a missing or invalid internal WebSocket receive timestamp, so the stale/casuality gate could accept a fill without receive-time evidence.

red_evidence.result: Before the fix, the missing-receive case was stored (fills_stored=1); removing the chronology guard reproduced storage of a receive-before-source fill (fills_stored=1).

entries.fix_summary: Quarantine missing/invalid receive timestamps and impossible source/receive chronology; emit an explicit warning.
entries.green_evidence: tests/test_user_fills_live_scan.py and tests/test_userfills_live.py: 24 passed; targeted Ruff and git diff --check passed.

entries.title: The userFills parser invented receive timestamps for absent or invalid input
entries.root_cause: The parser substituted a current wall-clock timestamp when received_at_ms was absent or invalid, fabricating latency and causal evidence.

red_evidence.result: Four absent/invalid receive-time cases failed before the fix.

entries.fix_summary: Preserve an unknown receive timestamp instead of manufacturing one; reject it from causal admission.
entries.green_evidence: The recorded targeted regression group passed 67 tests and Ruff passed.

entries.title: SAFE replay verifier unpacked four values from a three-value plan
entries.root_cause: _load_specs expected four return values although _load_replay_ready_plan returns proof, rows, and required.

red_evidence.result: GitHub run 40423849261 failed on the incompatible tuple contract.

entries.fix_summary: Match the canonical three-value restore contract and add a regression assertion.
entries.green_evidence: The recorded local SAFE/replay regression group passed 212 tests with 7 environment-limited skips; Ruff F/UP037 and git diff --check passed.

entries.title: Windows campaign lock treated os.kill(pid, 0) as a portable process-existence probe
entries.root_cause: The campaign lock used os.kill(pid, 0), whose signal-zero semantics are not portable to Windows and can be interpreted as a console Ctrl-C event.

red_evidence.test: H-T97 reproduction recorded 2026-10-26; three campaign-lock regression cases
red_evidence.result: All three targeted cases failed before replacing the probe; no shard was touched and no signal was sent by the tests.

entries.fix_summary: Use the existing cross-platform SingleWriterFileLock implementation for Copy-Vault campaign ownership.
entries.green_evidence: The recorded Windows lock regression group later passed 46 tests; targeted Ruff passed.

entries.title: Concurrent phase requests could commit against the same phase epoch
entries.root_cause: Phase mutation and analysis-stage advancement did not share one interprocess critical section, allowing two writers to act on the same observed epoch.

red_evidence.result: The race was reproduced with competing requests from one phase/epoch; only one transition may commit.

entries.fix_summary: Serialize phase mutation and stage advancement through the shared writer lock and validate the epoch before commit.
entries.green_evidence: The recorded phase-atomic regression group passed 58 tests; targeted Ruff passed.

entries.title: A Windows CMD regression test pinned an obsolete Git-sync build marker
entries.root_cause: The test expected linear-safe-relocation-v2 while the launcher and canonical engine had advanced to build v3.

red_evidence.test: Alina SAFE restore regression run 40679983201; Windows offline restore regression suite
red_evidence.result: One stale marker assertion failed while 144 tests passed.

entries.fix_summary: Compare the CMD-required build to the canonical GIT_SYNC_ENGINE_BUILD constant instead of hardcoding a version.
entries.green_evidence: Windows targeted suite passed 138 tests with 7 environment-limited skips; workflow contract passed 3 tests; Ruff and git diff --check passed.

entries.title: PnL semantic-audit test conflated arithmetic trust with strict settlement proof
entries.root_cause: The test applied funding without a settlement ID but expected strict PnL eligibility, contradicting the ledger's explicit incomplete-proof guard.

red_evidence.result: The test expectation disagreed with PaperLedger.apply_funding; the production strict-proof guard was correct.

entries.fix_summary: Separate the arithmetic TRUSTED audit assertion from strict proof and add a settled-funding counterpart.
entries.green_evidence: The corrected semantic-audit tests passed locally; the original guard was not weakened.
